The '''2012–13 Colorado Buffaloes men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Colorado]] in the [[2012–13 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. Head coach [[Tad Boyle]] was in his third season at Colorado. They were members of the [[Pac-12 Conference]] and played their home games at the [[Coors Events Center]]. They finished the season 21–12, 10–8 in Pac-12 play to finish in fifth place. They lost in the quarterfinals of the [[2013 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball tournament|Pac-12 tournament]] to Arizona.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.denverpost.com/2013/03/14/no-18-arizona-beats-colorado-79-69-at-pac-12/|title=No. 18 Arizona beats Colorado 79-69 at Pac-12|work=[[The Denver Post]]|date=March 14, 2013|access-date=February 4, 2024}}</ref> They received an at-large bid to the [[2013 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|2013 NCAA tournament]] where they lost in the second round to Illinois.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.denverpost.com/2013/03/22/cu-buffs-rally-then-fall-short-in-ncaa-tournament-loss-to-illinois/|title=CU Buffs rally then fall short in NCAA Tournament loss to Illinois|first=Tom|last=Kensler|work=[[The Denver Post]]|date=March 22, 2013|access-date=February 4, 2024}}</ref>
